content.short: Juni is a European financial platform for e-commerce and online advertising businesses with cards and accounts.
content.description: Juni is a European financial platform, founded in 2020 and based in Sweden, built for e-commerce and digital advertising businesses that operate across borders. From one account it offers multi-currency accounts, corporate cards with cashback tuned for ad spend, cross-border payments, and integrations with ad networks, payment providers and accounting tools. Juni also provides working-capital and inventory financing to help online sellers manage cash flow between buying stock and getting paid. By unifying banking, cards, FX and analytics around the needs of ecommerce operators, it helps digital-first businesses see profitability and reconcile revenue across the platforms they sell and advertise on.
